text.en: Asha used a map to find her way. "What do these symbols mean?" she asked.

A map is a drawing of the Earth's surface. Its parts include the title, scale, direction, legend and symbols. The scale shows how distances on the map relate to the ground, and the four main directions are north, south, east and west.
Latitudes run east-west and longitudes run north-south, and together they give the location of a place as a grid. The Equator is 0 degrees latitude and the Prime Meridian is 0 degrees longitude. Time zones follow longitude.
Maps show relief with contour lines, and we use colours and symbols for features. Topographic maps and the Survey of India sheets help us study areas. GIS and satellite images are modern aids.
